title: Silk in Motion — J1atelier’s Second Styling & Rotation Render Update
content:
![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202511/cc07ed8986654c27940181d6a75fbe10/images/6610d41b85074a0d98d46c52409ccb9ejewel%20rendering%20with%20pose%200361%201920.png)![7b3e153b725b4b88ab1694a36b5c0d58](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202511/cc07ed8986654c27940181d6a75fbe10/images/7b3e153b725b4b88ab1694a36b5c0d58jewel%20rendering%20with%20pose%200362%201920.png)

Hi everyone! 

Last week, I shared the **second version of my silk scarf styling** from the collection:

<https://connect.clo-set.com/ko/detail/dde0e857926b42229684b1b3b4630f64>

Since then, I’ve been working on the rotation render — it took almost a week to complete the animation, rendering, and edit the final video with sound to create the right atmosphere.

for the moment you can see this rotation video through my Instagram reels or my Youtube channel!

A full 360° render is now available:

[https://www.instagram.com/reel/DQuELECjzvH/?utm_source=ig_web_copy_link&igsh=MzRlODBiNWFlZA==](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DQuELECjzvH/?utm_source=ig_web_copy_link&igsh=MzRlODBiNWFlZA==)

<https://youtube.com/shorts/T-PaOWKIlkM?si=xKiefaxxg3GnRMSU>

And I’m also working on bringing **Genevieve** , my virtual muse, to life in this look —  
developing a close-up motion piece that captures her subtle expressions and gestures.

If you want to see the latest update, you know where to find it! ✨

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: That week of rendering was clearly worth it—the final 360° view is just mesmerizing and so satisfying to watch!
Reply 1: Thanks! I'm so glad to hear that, it really means a lot ❤️

Comment 2: How did you create such delicate drapes?😍 It's so perfect and this is so tutorial-worthy! If you made a tutorial, I'd watch it every single day!🙏🏻
Reply 1: I used to play with my mom’s scarves when I was little, and I remembered how I used to wrap them around my body — so I tried to recreate that same feeling by draping it on the avatar in CLO. I’m so glad you think it’s tutorial-worthy! That’s a great idea — I’ll definitely consider making one. Thank you so much for your comment! ❤️

Comment 3: The drapery is breathtaking! Everyone needs to see this!😍
Reply 1: Thank you for your comment! The flow and softness of silk were the main focus for this piece.❤️
content_description: Showcasing the latest 360° rotation render and styling updates of a silk scarf collection featuring the virtual muse Genevieve.

title: 🍂 Autumn Reverie
content:
There’s something about autumn light — the way it softens everything it touches.  
After months of intensity and movement, it feels like a quiet pause, suspended in gold and rose tones.

This project, _Autumn Reverie_ , was born from that feeling.  
A collaboration between **@thats.vii (Vincenzo Marchetti)** and me — where 3D environment and digital fashion meet under a single tree. 🌳

Vincenzo created a breathtaking world: cliffs wrapped in mist, skies painted in late sunset hues, and an atmosphere that feels like a dream slowly fading.  
I designed and animated the outfit — layers of plaid, lace, and structured fabric that move gently with the wind. The look embodies contrast: fragility and strength, nostalgia and serenity.

It’s more than a visual piece — it’s a state of mind.  
A reminder to slow down, to breathe in the stillness, to exist in the quiet beauty of the in-between. 🍁

![13468333ea3f42c984d28b852d3ad850](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202511/178c0a584b524142a44264d5e648a62e/images/13468333ea3f42c984d28b852d3ad8500035.png)![57700bb7013e427d97ca479094134720](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202511/178c0a584b524142a44264d5e648a62e/images/57700bb7013e427d97ca4790941347200350.png)![d98ff93aa0ae4219a5b1eddddd94ce27](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202511/178c0a584b524142a44264d5e648a62e/images/d98ff93aa0ae4219a5b1eddddd94ce270245.png)![0e819488dc4a4ac6b49dbb36dadf355c](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202511/178c0a584b524142a44264d5e648a62e/images/0e819488dc4a4ac6b49dbb36dadf355c0092.png)![d9b49884ee2744fb9e31c7f3ecc43e2d](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202511/178c0a584b524142a44264d5e648a62e/images/d9b49884ee2744fb9e31c7f3ecc43e2d0200.png)

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: What a stunning collaboration!

Comment 2: Ooh I like the vibe - the overall look feels so autumn!

Comment 3: The nostalgic atmosphere has completely charmed me too!😍
